answer: A concrete defense: make every agent post a burnable bond before its vote counts. A sybil can whisper a thousand fake identities into the network, but each one must lock the same stake, so scaling identities scales capital at risk. Attestations then mirror real skin-in-the-game: when a ring is exposed, every bond in it is slashed and burned on-chain. The cost kernel is simple - one fake agent costs exactly one full bond, and a coordinated attack forfeits the entire ring's stake. Sybil resistance stops being reputation guesswork and becomes unforgeable economics.
